request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 5000 pcs of rubber yoga mat 6 mm. The most we are willing to pay: USD 4.36 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Santos. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Silver Crane Plastics
Supplier message:
Dear friend,
Thanks for your inquiry about the rubber yoga mat 6 mm.
Unit price 5.40 USD (FCA Qingdao).
If you prefer, we can also offer DDP to your warehouse at USD 7.26 per pcs.
Minimum order 1000 pcs.
Production time about 4 weeks.
Payment: 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment.
Any question please let me know.
Have a nice day
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":5.4,"currency":"USD","moq":1000,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":28,"incoterm":"FCA","payment_terms":"30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment"}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Silver Crane team,

Thank you for your quote. Your FCA Qingdao price of USD 5.40 per pc is above what we can accept. We can proceed at USD 4.36 per pc, FCA Qingdao, for 5000 pcs, with 6 mm rubber yoga mats, logo printing and export cartons.

Please confirm the following so we can finalise: (1) whether USD 4.36 FCA Qingdao is acceptable to you, (2) your payment terms for this order, (3) the lead time from order and deposit to shipment, (4) the logo printing setup cost and any plate or artwork fees, and (5) the carton specification and whether the packaging is included in the unit price.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards"}
